body:
I think it's the same issue, what I have is this code:

```vue
      <VtigerInput
        v-for="field of fields"
        :key="field.name"
        v-model="user[field.name as keyof typeof user] as string"
        :field="field"
      />
```

That now gives this error:

```
Expected "]" but found ":"
243 |            key: field.name,
244 |            modelValue: _unref(user)[field.name,
245 |            "onUpdate:modelValue": ($event: any) => ((_unref(user)[field.name) = $event),
    |                                 ^
246 |            field: field
247 |          }, null, 8, ["modelValue", "onUpdate:modelValue", "field"]))
```
Yes, it is the same issue: last character `]` is removed from property value where TypeScript is used
This appears to have been caused by https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/13397. Reverting this locally fixes the failure.
The Vapor compiler in 3.6.0-alpha.3 seems to not have this issue, even though it contains #13395, which seems to be a nearly identical change.

I believe this is happening because of the slice on the string here: https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/13397/files#diff-4159ce11acf9eca18d86c2fd3dbb37946bd01f074c892e9334523a12a2875d8bR359

The test only checks if `<string>(myvar)` works, not `myvar as string`

> The Vapor compiler in 3.6.0-alpha.3 seems to not have this issue

@AaronDewes I checked, and 3.6.0-alpha.3 has this issue. I had to roll back to 3.6.0-alpha.2.

> > The Vapor compiler in 3.6.0-alpha.3 seems to not have this issue
> 
> [@AaronDewes](https://github.com/AaronDewes) I checked, and 3.6.0-alpha.3 has this issue. I had to roll back to 3.6.0-alpha.2.

Are you using the vapor compiler?

I tried in the playground, and alpha 3 fails [without Vapor mode](https://play.vuejs.org/#), but succeeds [if I enable vapor mode](https://play.vuejs.org/#).

(Please note: For some reason, the Vapor playground link only works if I make an edit in the editor, otherwise it fails for me, but the edit can be anything, including adding a comment or a space)

> Are you using the vapor compiler?

Nope. I misunderstood. I meant that issue is also present in 3.6.0-alpha.3
Sorry, I shouldn't have removed TypeScript in the expression. https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/13397 should be revert.
